entities.summary: Danylo Danylovych Lyder was a Ukrainian set designer, and teacher. He was a member of the National Academy of Arts of Ukraine, the National Union of Artists of Ukraine, the National Union of Theater Actors of Ukraine, and Taras Shevchenko National Prize Committee of Ukraine.
